description: Department of Trade & Investment - Regulations issued on "Special Deposit Accounts"
categorisation: This gazette contains regulations made under the Foreign Exchange Act, No. 12 of 2017, specifically regarding Special Deposit Accounts. It establishes legal/regulatory frameworks for foreign exchange management, including eligibility criteria, declaration requirements, and operational procedures. While it includes a minister's name at the end, this is a standard legal notification format and the primary content is regulatory in nature, falling under Legal/Regulatory classification rather than government personnel or structural changes.
